logo.modifications: Whale path extracted without the wordmark; white fill and desktop icon placement.

whaleTail.source: 02-Porcelain.icon from the Whale App Icon Studies, made in Icon Composer with design generation 27
whaleTail.layer: whale-cobalt.svg, copied unchanged: the whale-tail outline stroked 15.5 units wide in #3563BF on a 256-unit canvas.

artwork.background: Beta and Next: the Porcelain automatic gradient from extended sRGB 0.93, 0.95, 0.98. Stable: system-dark.
artwork.whale: Beta and Next keep the Porcelain group effects: a neutral shadow at 0.18 opacity and translucency 0.12.
artwork.badge: Same capsule, placement and effects for Next and Beta; system heavy text with identical size and tracking, converted to SVG outlines. The Stable composition preserves the badge group with hidden set to true.

tray: Beta and Next cut assets/tray-*.png from the whale-tail layer during icons:export: black macOS template images and #3563BF Windows and Linux images, recorded in each app-icon.resources.json. Stable keeps the images derived from dsh-plugin-desktop/build/tray-icon.svg.
macPackaging: Stable, Beta and Next mac.icon compile build/app-icon.icon directly; app-icon.icns is generated by actool for legacy macOS and the DMG volume. Raster exports serve Windows, Linux and unpackaged Electron development.
